$comment: bench/taxonomy.json — the BUDGETED bench manifest (L.W7 S6, Lane 33, audit ⚠34).
Extended at P.W1 S2 to cover the compositor-SoA frontier + the sync-step
run-check suite + the color2Into cross-repo dispatch.
proof:bench-runs is a RUN-CHECK: a bench runs, a positive `hz` is emitted, no
budget is asserted (a 2x regression prints a slower number and the gate stays
GREEN). Two gaps follow (L.W7.md §S6): (1) no bench covers the value.js color-math
alloc claims (VJ.L1-VJ.L8 / W78-W85 — transformMat3/oklab2xyz/mixColors/
gamutMapToRgbSpace), and (2) every bench-backed SOTA claim (the lerpArray SoA win,
the warmEngine pre-resolve) is un-budgeted.
This manifest maps each bench case to ONE category. proof:bench-taxonomy reads it
and enforces the contract per category:
run-check    — bench runs and emits positive `hz`; no budget asserted (delegates
to proof:bench-runs's finite-positive-hz check).
observe-only — bench runs; result recorded; no floor; re-run sets a new baseline.
budgeted     — `hz` must exceed `floorHz` (a recorded baseline x fraction); the
floor lives in `floorHz` below, derived per the named fraction.
cross-repo   — the case targets a SIBLING (value.js color-math); EXCLUDED from kf
CI; asserted PRESENT in KF-TO-VALUEJS-O-ASKS.md (the Tranche O
dispatch). The bench is value.js's to author + run.
inv-L-device-honesty: a `budgeted` floor is a device-DEPENDENT wall-clock predicate;
the gate declares `observe-only` posture for the budgeted arm in CI (RECORDED, not
RED on the slow runner) and HARD on-device/local. The taxonomy STRUCTURE (every case
covered, every cross-repo ask present) is device-INDEPENDENT and HARD everywhere.
BORN-RED today: proof:bench-taxonomy does not exist (no script, no package.json
entry) and this manifest's `budgeted` cases name bench arms that L.W7's cures have
not shipped yet (warmEngine pre-resolve). The gate RED-s until the script + manifest
+ the named budgeted bench arms all exist.
